left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  The patient is currently being treated at Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital  [OR] or Kamuzu Central Hospital in the neonatal ward
-  The patient is less than 28 days old (neonate)

right.raw_text: -  The patient is deemed to be at risk  [OR] for jaundice or the patient is undergoing blue light phototherapy for treatment of jaundice

left.raw_text: -  The patient's parent or guardian has provided informed consent for their child to participate

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Parent or guardian is unable or unwilling to provide informed consent

right.raw_text: -  The patient is unable to receive a blood draw/ [OR] heel stick as determined by their clinician
